_comment: Maps each BLB non-Core domain to the repository that owns it and the contract path it mounts at in the composed app. Used by scripts/ci/compose-domain.php to check out cross-domain dependencies during domain CI, and by scripts/ci/setup-sonar.php for SonarCloud project + SONAR_TOKEN bootstrap. Keys are the domain segment of a module id (people/attendance -> people). Core is intentionally absent because it ships in the platform repository. Extensions are intentionally excluded because this shared CI does not govern their relaxed repository layout.
